senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. נוּחַ)to be at ease.
units: Ex. R. s. 20 (homiletic interpret. of נָחָם, Ex. XIII, 17) אמר הקב״ה איני מתנחם וכ׳ the Lord said, I shall not be contented, until &c., for we read ולא נָחַם (perhaps meant for נִחַם Nif.).

senses.gloss: to comfort, console. Pesik. Naḥ., p. 128ᵃ א״ל הקב״ה אני ואתם נלך ונְנַחֲמֶנָּה the Lord said to them (the prophets), Myself and you, let us go and comfort her (Jerusalem); ib. נַחֲמוּהָ עמי וכ׳ comfort her, O my people; comfort her, you on high (angels) &c. Ib. הקב״ה שלחני אצלך לנַחֲמֵךְ the Lord sent me to thee (Jerusalem) to comfort thee. Ib.ᵇ נַחֲמוּנִי נחמוני עמי comfort me, comfort me, O my people.
units: <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 30:1">Pesik. R. s. 30</cite> <he>ונכנסו חביריו לנַחֲמוֹ</he> and his friends came in to comfort him; <he>אם על אשתו מְנַחֲמִים לו וכ׳</he> if it is for the loss of his wife that they seek to console him, and he refuses to be consoled &c.

Midd. II, 2 השוכן בבית הזה יְנַחֶמְךָ may He who resides in this house console thee. Y. Gitt. V, 47ᶜ top; Y. Dem. IV, 24ᵃ bot. ומְנַחֲמִין אבילי וכ׳ and you must comfort the gentile mourners (of your place) as well as the Jewish mourners; Y. Ab. Zar. I, 39ᶜ bot. ניחמים (corr. acc.); Tosef. Gitt. V (III), 5; a. fr.—מְנַחֵם the consoling friend of the mourner.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 947:1">Yalk. Prov. 947</cite> <he>בבית האבל בחול פריס מנ׳ ויהיב לאבל … יש לה מנ׳ פריס מנ׳ וכ׳</he> in the house of the mourner, on week days, the comforter breaks the bread and gives it to the mourner, as it is written (<cite ref="Lamentations 1:17">Lam. I, 17</cite>), ‘Zion breaks (the bread) with her own hands, she has no comforter’, but if she had a comforter, the comforter would break it &c.—Pl. <he>מְנַחֲמִים</he>, <he>מְנַחֲמִין</he>.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 27a:20">M. Kat. 27ᵃ</cite> <he>בית המנ׳</he> the room where the comforters meet.

<cite ref="Moed Katan 27b:9">Ib. 27ᵇ</cite> <he>כיון שניענע … אין מנ׳ וכ׳</he> as soon as the mourner nods with his head (indicating that he accepts their consolations), the friends are no longer permitted to sit with him; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 152a:16">Sabb. 152ᵃ</cite> <he>מת שאין לו מנ׳</he> a deceased person that leaves no direct relations to be comforted.

senses.gloss: to be comforted, accept consolation. Pesik. l. c. מי צריך להִנָּחֵם which of them is in need of being comforted?; ib. להִתְנַחֵם.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 19a:8">Ib.</cite> <he>מִתְנַחֵם מאחרים</he> receiving consolations from others. Pesik. R. l. c. <he>ואינו מתנחם</he>, v. supra.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 84:21">Gen. R. s. 84</cite> <he>מִתְנַחֲמִים על המתים וכ׳</he> people accept consolation for dead persons but not for living ones (that have disappeared); a. fr.—

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 27:4">Gen. R. s. 27</cite> (expl. <he>וינחם</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 6:6">Gen. VI, 6</cite>) <he>מתנ׳ אני שבראתי וכ׳</he> I have that consolation that I created him (man) to live on earth below &c.

senses.gloss: to seek comfort; to be sorry, regret, reconsider. Ib. מתנ׳ אני שעשיתו וכ׳ I regret that I made him, and that he was placed on earth.
units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 45">Ex. R. s. 45</cite>, beg. <he>ואני מתנ׳ עליו</he> and I am sorry for him (reconsider my judgment).

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 23:8">Num. R. s. 23</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Numbers 23:19">Num. XXIII, 19</cite>) <he>לא בן עמרם עשה אותו להִנָּחֵם</he> did not the son of Amram cause him (God) to reconsider (<cite ref="Exodus 32:14">Ex. XXXII, 14</cite>); <cite ref="Exodus 32:14">ib.</cite> <he>להִתְנַחֵם</he>; Y. Taan. I, 65ᵇ bot. <he>שעשה לאל שיִתְנֶחָם</he>; a. fr.
